review_notes: I read the whole file and checked its main definitions against what Mathlib already has. Those definitions are the IsLinear mixins, symmₗ, linearMapAt, coordChangeL, continuousLinearMapAt, symmL, continuousLinearEquivAt, zeroSection, VectorBundle, VectorBundleCore, VectorPrebundle, and inCoordinates. I grepped Mathlib/Topology for other zero-section or section definitions and found none apart from this file. The IsLinear mixins, the "extend by zero" linear maps, and the Core and Prebundle structures are vector-bundle versions of the FiberBundle analogues in Mathlib/Topology/FiberBundle. They add linearity and operator-norm continuity, so they are not duplicates. The Index, Base and Fiber wrappers in VectorBundleCore exist for dot notation and typeclass inference. They follow the same pattern as FiberBundleCore and are not a separate duplicate concept. I found no definition in this file that duplicates an existing Mathlib, Batteries or core concept. I did not search every Mathlib file, so a duplicate in an unrelated area is still possible.
